user.title: Crestron CIP Bridge
user.description: Auto starts Home Assistant as CIP IP ID 03, then hands the session to the iPad when it connects through the proxy. Proxy mode waits for the iPad, and Standalone mode connects Home Assistant directly.

data_description.connection_mode: Auto is recommended when both HA and the iPad should work. It switches between a direct HA session and the iPad proxy session.

abort.already_configured: This AV3 endpoint is already configured.

discover.title: Discovered CIP points
discover.description: Choose a point received from the AV3 during synchronization or live feedback.

test.title: Test point
test.description: Sending a test can operate connected equipment. Digital tests send a momentary button press; analog tests send the value entered below. Leave Send test command unchecked to continue without sending.

object61.title: Object 61 light naming preview

capture.title: Record an iPad action
capture.description: Status: {status}; events: {count}; connection: {mode}. Start, perform ONE action on the iPad through this proxy, then reopen this menu and Stop. Download diagnostics before reloading HA. Recording stops after 5 minutes or 2000 events. Starting replaces the previous recording. Includes display text; sends no commands.

data.label: Describe the action you will perform

digital_control.title: Add experimental digital control

error.no_points: No points observed yet. Connect the iPad or wait for the AV3's initial sync, then open this menu again.
error.test_failed: The point test could not be sent. Check the CIP connection and try again.

abort.object61_incomplete: All six Object 61 light labels have not been received yet. Wait for synchronization, then try again.
abort.capture_started: Recording started. Perform one iPad action through the proxy, then reopen Configure → Record an iPad action to stop. Download diagnostics before reloading.
abort.capture_stopped: Recording stopped. Download diagnostics from the integration entry menu. The recording stays in memory until reload or a new recording.
